observations.behavior: Adds a new method get_retryable_errors returning a set of error status strings, and a test asserting those strings are recognized.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the warehouse ingestion worker to distinguish transient, self-recovering API failures (429, 5xx) from permanent exceptions, preventing transient failures from being recorded as tracked exceptions or causing unnecessary alerting. This supports reliability of the warehouse ingestion pipeline.
